 Print Directed by Balaji Tharaneetharan , 'Baththa ', starring Vijay Sethupathi , was released in theatres on October 1. With the release of 'Baththa' on OTT platforms, it has become the buzz of the town with its impeccable combination of humor, emotions, and story. Fans have even come up with reviews on social media. They appreciate the acting and scriptwriting. They give special credit to the chemistry of Vijay Sethupathi and child artist Sai Prithviraj. Vijay Sethupathi's 'Baththa' OTT release receives positive fan reviews
 After the release of 'Baththa' on Netflix on October 29, several fans have come up with reviews on social media. One fan termed it an awesome movie and complimented the acting of Vijay Sethupathi and the young actor. The fan also added, "There is no melodrama or in-your-face falseness. Worth watching multiple times." Another viewer described it as a "beautiful, soulful film" that makes audiences experience different emotions before leaving them satisfied. Several fans have also thanked director Balaji Tharaneetharan for delivering such a heartfelt story. Fans praise Vijay Sethupathi and young actor Sai Prithviraj
 Vijay Sethupathi's performance seems to be one of the most discussed aspects in the online responses. A viewer highlighted the choices made by the actor for scripts saying, "Vijay Sethupathi always remains ahead when it comes to different script choices and it pays well to him". This fan stressed on how the movie Baththa once again proved the acting skill of choosing an interesting story line by him. Moreover, scenes including Vijay Sethupathi and the little boy were noteworthy. A viewer recalled a conversation between the two characters under a tree, praising the writing and the way the boy admits his mistake. Another fan gave the film a five-star rating and wrote, "Such a feel-good movie. Loved it." The viewer also revealed that the emotional scenes brought tears to their eyes during an early-morning watch. About the 'Baththa' story, cast, and OTT details
 Directed by Balaji Tharaneetharan, 'Baththa' revolves around a young boy who accidentally locks a feared gangster inside a school toilet. Vijay Sethupathi plays the gangster, while Sai Prithviraj appears as the boy. This strange situation results in a series of funny and emotionally charged events for the two protagonists. The cast also includes Lijomol Jose, Santhy Balachandran , Ajay Ghosh and Arjun Chidambaram. The music for the film is by Sai Abhyankkar and the song ‘Magale’ has attracted attention on social media. Currently available on Netflix in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Kannada and Malayalam, the movie reaches a wider audience. Poll Vote & Share your view
